out.subject: Volume agreement for stainless bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the cost components. We appreciate the transparency, but would like you to price our requirement on the basis of a firm volume agreement rather than your standard terms.

Our annual requirement is fixed at 23700 kg. Under the proposed agreement, we would commit bindingly to that annual volume over 36 months. I have attached our shared monthly forecast; the supporting forecast reference is included below.

Our proposal is EUR 4.76 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and a 36-month contract, without a price adjustment clause. This gives Werdenfels a firm volume basis for purchasing and stock planning.

Please review this package and let us know what price you can offer us as a committed volume customer on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Open with a firm annual volume commitment and a long-term package, supported by the shared forecast. Acknowledge the supplier's cost explanation while requesting pricing that reflects the volume agreement.

out.subject: Volume commitment and revised price proposal
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for accepting the payment terms and welcoming the volume commitment. We can commit bindingly to 23700 kg per year under the proposed 36-month agreement. That is our fixed annual requirement; we cannot offer a higher annual quantity. I have attached the forecast again for your review.

We understand your requirement for an AS-14404 alloy surcharge clause over this duration. Our revised proposal is EUR 4.88 per kg, with 90 days net payment and a 36-month contract, without a price adjustment clause. If you retain the surcharge clause in your counteroffer, please set out clearly how it separates the alloy component from the base price.

Your own purchase-order history provides a concrete basis for reviewing the price; see the figures below. Please take this revised package to your pricing committee for approval rather than limiting the review to the routine sales adjustment. We appreciate your willingness to work with us on a volume agreement.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Moves the price upward on the same payment and contract package, answers the volume question precisely, acknowledges the supplier's surcharge condition without proposing a clause, and supports committee review with its own purchase-order history.

out.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for taking the package to management and improving your offer. Your clarification that the surcharge applies only to the 45% alloy share, while the base price remains fixed, is helpful.

I note that you verified the purchase-order history but have not changed your calculation on that basis. For the next review, please consider the public AS-14404 data referenced below alongside the cost drivers you cited.

We are moving our proposal to EUR 5.02 per kg, with 90 days net payment and a 36-month contract, without a price adjustment clause. The binding annual volume of 23700 kg remains part of this package.

I understand that you require the alloy clause in your counteroffer. Please ask your pricing committee to review the starting price against the referenced market data, keeping the distinction between the fixed base price and the alloy component clear. We appreciate the constructive review so far.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Move upward on the same payment and contract package, acknowledge the supplier's management review and surcharge explanation, and introduce a single verified alloy-index reference for a further price review.
